findings.claim: The new ReportIfLocatedInCompilation wrapper is applied to every diagnostic the TypeCollector reports, not only the ones that were crashing. It drops any diagnostic whose location is in a source tree that is not part of the current compilation. A diagnostic with Location.None (IsInSource is false) is still reported. The change is therefore broader than the crash fix. Diagnostics that previously surfaced in users' builds could now disappear. Before the change, a MsgPack diagnostic on a member inherited from a base type in a referenced assembly would crash or report with no location. After the change, some of those cases are silently suppressed.

receipt_plan.detail: Analyzer test: a [MessagePackObject] class in the compiling assembly derives from a base class in a referenced assembly, and the base has a public property with no [Key]. Run it on base and head and compare the reported MsgPack004 diagnostics. Also test a type declared in the same assembly with a missing key, and assert that the diagnostic is still reported at head.

findings.claim: The MemberNeedsKey diagnostic now passes a null location when the member is declared in metadata. Diagnostic.Create(descriptor, null, ...) yields Location.None. For an inherited public member with no [Key], MsgPack004 will therefore be reported with no location, which is a user-visible warning/error that was not there before (the old code crashed). The location is not anchored to the derived type's identifier. The error-severity diagnostic cannot be navigated to or suppressed in source.

receipt_plan.detail: Analyzer test: a source type inherits a keyless public property from a metadata base class. Assert the MsgPack004 location, and check that the build output has a diagnostic with no file or line.
